A solid orange-yellow shape fills the frame, angled diagonally from top left to bottom right. The color is uniform and consistent across the image, with no visible texture, patterns, or gradients. No text, objects, or actions are present.
A red rectangle is centered on a black background. The rectangle is uniformly colored and positioned horizontally.
